document: Olympic Dam Expansion Draft Environmental Impact Statement 2009, Chapter 2
role: Primary operator written operational facts only; all photos/diagrams/figure geometry unused.
facts: In 2009 most ore hoisting used the Clarke shaft; Whenan provided an additional hoisting route.
The Robinson shaft had ceased operating as a hoisting shaft and served as a ventilation intake.
Surface infrastructure included a concentrator, smelter, refinery and hydrometallurgical plant.
limits: The reviewed written section does not give an aboveground headframe height or establish which unnamed native point corresponds to each named shaft. Underground shaft depths are not exterior tower heights.
